in_marathi.name: Basvesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the forest
in_marathi.long_meaning: Basvesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Basvesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'vasa' which means 'to reside' and 'eshana' which means 'Lord of'. This name is used to denote the Lord of the forest who protects and nurtures all living beings. In Hindu mythology, Basvesh is an incarnation of Lord Shiva, the god of destruction and creation.
